title: SPI controller (master): modes 0..3, 8-bit frames MSB first, programmable SCLK, two chip selects
features: The controller role that the SPI_top target does not cover: sensor, panel, PMIC and flash control.
CMD.start sends TX_DATA and receives RX_DATA in one frame; DONE when it ends.
CPOL is the SCLK idle level; CPHA 0 samples on the leading edge, CPHA 1 on the trailing edge.
Half an SCLK period is DIV + 1 clocks; CS[i] drives csn[i] low, held by software across the frames of a transaction.

fields.desc: 0 sample on the leading edge, 1 on the trailing edge

regs.name: TX_DATA
regs.desc: Byte sent by the next frame

fields.desc: send one frame; ignored while busy

regs.name: RX_DATA
regs.desc: Byte received by the last frame

sequence: Write DIV and CFG (mode, then CS to select the target).
For each byte: TX_DATA, CMD.start, wait for DONE, read RX_DATA.
Write CFG.cs = 0 to end the transaction.
notes: sclk, mosi, miso and csn are the SPI pins; they pass through unchanged.
